article.title: Priority宣布收購Fireberry，擬把CRM與雲端ERP串連
article.title_en: Priority announces Fireberry acquisition and planned CRM–ERP integration
article.summary: 11月5日公司公告擴展銷售、行銷自動化及服務能力，保留獨立方案。
article.summary_en: The November 5 company release expands sales, marketing automation and service capabilities while retaining a standalone option.
highlights: Fireberry把銷售、行銷及服務放在同一CRM。
整合後的AI代理及統一資料能力屬公告中的規劃。
highlights_en: Fireberry combines sales, marketing and service in one CRM.
Combined AI-agent and unified-data capabilities are described as planned benefits.
article.why: CRM與營運資料相接，會影響行銷團隊如何管理潛客、訂單與售後交接。
article.why_en: Connecting CRM and operations affects lead, order and service handoffs.
article.next_step: 現有客戶可向供應商索取整合時間表、資料權限及獨立方案的支援安排。
article.next_step_en: Existing customers should request integration timing, data permissions and standalone support details.
article.detail: Priority把這宗收購定位為業務管理產品組合的擴展。新聞稿使用未來式描述整合方案將提供的分析、AI代理及統一資料能力，未能據此判定每項功能已在所有客戶帳戶開放。獨立CRM的選項亦有保留。行銷主管現階段最實際的工作，是列出名單、活動、訂單與客戶服務之間的資料交接需求，再要求供應商交代實際可交付範圍。
article.detail_en: The issuer positions the deal as a portfolio expansion. Future-tense integration claims do not establish feature access for every customer. With a standalone CRM option retained, teams should map campaign, lead, order and service handoffs before committing to migration.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
